query:
Two people observe that Adaeze saying 'it's fine' about the Christmas fund has become a recurring pattern and that the issue deserves to be put on the agenda properly. Which of the following made this specific observation — and what in how they expressed it distinguishes their message from the other person who said something similar immediately before?

Options:
A. Obiageli
B. Chisom
C. Nkechi
D. Ifeoma
context:
[1] (about=Chisom, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:31:00) Ada you always say it's fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you
[2] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Fund contributions to be transferred before 1st December; Adaeze will chase.
[4] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:36:00) Adaeze and I have already discussed this privately. She will brief me on the process after Christmas.
[5] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:27:00) I think what might help is someone sets a group schedule for Christmas Day so we are not winging it. Last year the video call with Aunty Oby started two hours late because nobody had tested the link.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Kingsley, group-interaction, t8 @2025-11-16T16:22:00) Kingsley has booked the venue for the summer party; confirmation forwarded to Adaeze.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Nkechi asks Kingsley to sort the Christmas fund half before Friday.
[8] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:33:00) Greetings my people. Six years. I have been watching Adaeze carry this and I will say it again in this chat, plainly: someone else in this family should be learning this process from her. Not next year. Now.
agent_answer:
Obiageli (option A) made this specific observation.

Chisom said something similar just before: “Ada you always say it’s fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you” — an empathetic, informal observation of the pattern.

Obiageli’s message is distinguished by turning that observation into a concrete demand for action/agenda: she says she has “been waiting two years” for Adaeze to stop saying “it is fine,” and explicitly instructs, “I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.” In the memory slice she also says “someone else in this family should be learning this process from her. Not next year. Now.” So Obiageli names the recurring pattern and insists it be formalised rather than merely acknowledged.
